examples.text: Pensavo che Tom fosse un tuo amico del liceo.
examples.en: I thought Tom was a friend of yours from high school.

examples.text: Mia sorella ha sposato un suo compagno di classe del liceo.
examples.en: My sister married one of her high school classmates.

examples.text: Tom era nel club di kyudo quando era al liceo.
examples.en: Tom was in the kyudo club when he was in high school.

examples.text: Qual'era la tua materia preferita al liceo?
examples.en: What was your favorite subject in high school?
